text:
maria: Quick async — LumenHealth private cutover is scheduled for tomorrow (PDT). I'm compiling a final gating checklist. Need clear owners for: egress/NAT, firewall rules, KMS/HSM onboarding, canary traffic/rollout, and deploy freeze. Anyone?

kevin: I'll take egress NAT + firewall rules. Need confirmation of the customer IPs and port ranges. Do we want SNAT on the NAT gateway or NAT instance? :thumbsup:

raul: I'll own canary rollout + smoke tests. Planning to run canary against the staging mirror. Which model variants do we pin?

maria: Pin to rdlw-2.1 and fallback to rdlw-2.0 (agreed in previous runbook).

sophie: CS confirms customer won't stream external syslog. They DO require HSM/KMS access for key wrapping. Who's owning KMS onboarding on our side?

lina: I own KMS/HSM onboarding. I'll need the customer's IAM role ARN and a CSR for host certs. Also note an airgap blocker: artifact signing for image v1.2.5 hasn't completed — blocker until signed image available.

kevin: Draft firewall/NACL snippet I'm planning to apply (confirm before merge):
```
# NACL example (apply in staging then prod)
Allow TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB
Allow TCP 5432 from customer-peering-cidr (10.152.0.0/20) to DB subnet
Allow UDP 53 from our egress prober IPs to 8.8.8.8 (if prober needed)
```

raul: Canary smoke check (I'll add to CI smoke script):
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY_TOKEN" https://staging-lumen.redwood/api/health
# expect 200 and p95 < 200ms
```

ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary window reserved 2026-03-19T16:00-17:00Z. Preflight automated checks scheduled at -60m and -15m.

maria: Action items (TL;DR): Kevin — post final rule diff here and open infra PR; Lina — complete signing or flag blocker; Raul — share smoke script PR and run preflight; Sophie — chase customer for CSR and IAM ARN; I'll be on call and coordinate cutover channel. If blockers surface by 11:00 PT tomorrow we abort.

kevin: Firewall PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/842 :eyes: I'll hold merging until Lina signs off on the NACL and we have the exact peer CIDR.

lina: Signing scheduled for 12:30 PT tomorrow but I need the CSR by 11:45 PT to make it. Sophie, can you confirm with them? Airgap artifact signing is the only blocking dependency from our side.

sophie: Just pinged their infra contact in the customer channel — asked for CSR + IAM info, they replied "sending by EOD" (so hopeful). I'll escalate if not received by EOD.

raul: small config note — I'll disable prefix cache during canary to avoid noisy cache warm-up. PR for config toggle: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/2156. Will run smoke 10m pre-canary and 2m post-canary, tagging @kevin @lina.

maria: Another check — do we have audit log retention set per contract (7 years)? Customer asked about retention and export. I'll confirm and post back.

kevin: Quick smoke check from bastion to verify egress path (run before canary):
```
nc -vz 54.33.210.9 443 && curl -sS https://54.33.210.9/health || echo "egress failed"
```

raul: Got it. I'll add that to the preflight. Also will pin canary to a single replica and route 1% traffic initially.

sophie: noted on retention; assigning to @maria to confirm with compliance. Customer also asked if we can provide KMS audit logs post-cutover.

maria: I'll confirm retention and KMS audit export. If all go/no-go checks pass by 12:00 PT tomorrow we proceed with the canary at 16:00Z. If anything slips or the signed image isn't available we abort and reschedule. Thanks all — please update this thread with final diffs/PR links. :pray:
